description: The clause with a negative literal at each true coordinate of a row and a positive literal at each false coordinate is false exactly on that row.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval_rowClause.{u} {α : Type u} {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → α) (r : Fin n → Bool)
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.clauseFormula
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.rowClause p r)) =
      false ↔
    v ∘ p = r
